JavaScript / WebAssembly runtime:
https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/v/0.10.32
https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe

Pose Landmarker Lite model, float16, version 1:
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/pose_landmarker/pose_landmarker_lite/float16/1/pose_landmarker_lite.task
Model card (includes the Apache 2.0 license declaration):
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/Model%20Card%20BlazePose%20GHUM%203D.pdf
https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/pose_landmarker

Runtime and model are served from this site's own origin. Camera frames are
processed in the browser; vli.bar does not upload camera images or microphone
audio. Monocular world landmarks are estimates, not measured room positions.
